packageRules.description: GitHub Actions minor/patch: merged once CI is green, no release (the plugin doesn't change); major by hand
Traefik/Yaegi test versions minor/patch: CI runs the plugin against the new version; merged when green, no release. A red PR means the new Traefik broke the plugin.
Major updates (Traefik v4): PR only, merged by hand
